overview.title: How Genre Works as a Craft Tool
overview.content:
Genre isn't just a marketing category—it's a lens that shapes how you tell a story. Each genre brings its own conventions for pacing, voice, sensory emphasis, and structure. When you understand these conventions, you can use them deliberately in your memoir to highlight different aspects of the same experience.

The same moment can feel urgent (thriller), atmospheric (noir), emotionally charged (romance), or philosophically profound (literary fiction). Genre conventions guide readers on how to read your work and what to pay attention to.

This tool helps you see these conventions in action by transforming your memoir scene through different genre lenses, showing you the specific craft choices that create each effect.

noir.name: Noir
noir.teachingPoint: Noir uses short, clipped sentences and cynical observations. It emphasizes light/shadow imagery, moral ambiguity, and a world-weary tone. Metaphors tend toward the dark and fatalistic. The narrator observes details with suspicious attention.
craftElements: Short, punchy sentences create urgency and tension
Heavy use of shadow/light imagery and urban metaphors
Details framed as potential clues or warnings
Fatalistic tone—things always turn out badly

thriller.name: Thriller
thriller.teachingPoint: Thriller accelerates pacing through active verbs and time pressure. Sentences fragment under tension. Ordinary moments gain urgency through the narrator's heightened awareness of threat or danger. Every detail might be significant.
craftElements: Active, urgent verbs drive momentum forward
Ordinary details reframed as potential threats

romance.name: Romance
romance.teachingPoint: Romance slows down to savor emotional and physical sensations. Sentences lengthen and flow. The narrative focuses on warmth, connection, longing, and the interior emotional landscape. Metaphors often draw from nature and beauty.
craftElements: Sensory details emphasize warmth and beauty
Metaphors of connection, growth, and light
Focus on relationships and emotional bonds

literary.name: Literary Fiction
literary.teachingPoint: Literary Fiction prioritizes language, metaphor, and philosophical depth. It dwells in observation and reflection. Sentences are complex and lyrical. The ordinary becomes profound through careful attention and poetic language.
craftElements: Complex, layered sentences with poetic rhythm
Attention to language as craft, not just vehicle
Universal themes emerge from specific moments

horror.name: Horror
horror.teachingPoint: Horror transforms the familiar into the uncanny and threatening. It uses visceral body sensations, creeping dread, and isolation. Details that seem innocent become ominous. The narrative voice carries an undercurrent of fear.
craftElements: Building sense of dread and wrongness
Familiar situations made uncanny and threatening
Sentence rhythm creates unease and tension

scifi.name: Science Fiction
scifi.teachingPoint: Science Fiction uses precise, clinical language and technological metaphors. It reframes experiences through a speculative lens, seeing systems and patterns. The narrative maintains emotional distance while analyzing the mechanics of human behavior.
craftElements: Focus on patterns, systems, and mechanisms

mystery.name: Mystery
mystery.teachingPoint: Mystery frames experiences as puzzles to be solved. Details are clues. The narrator adopts an investigative stance, asking questions and weighing evidence. Information is revealed strategically, creating curiosity and suspense.
craftElements: Emphasis on what's hidden or unexplained

magical-realism.name: Magical Realism
magical-realism.teachingPoint: Magical Realism blends the ordinary and impossible with matter-of-fact acceptance. Extraordinary elements appear without explanation or fanfare. The narrative maintains a steady, accepting tone even as reality bends, creating dreamlike atmosphere.
craftElements: Matter-of-fact tone even during impossible events
Blurred boundaries between real and impossible
